tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Public profile card (name, photos, bio, gender, distance basis) for one user by id — the same data shown on swipe cards and match previews

tools.name: save_my_profile
tools.description: Create or update the caller's own dating profile (identity is server-derived; a client can never write another user's profile)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO profiles (user_id, display_name, dob, bio, gender, looking_for, photos_json, lat, lng, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :display_name, :dob, :bio, :gender, :looking_for, :photos_json, :lat, :lng, :updated_at) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, dob = excluded.dob, bio = excluded.bio, gender = excluded.gender, looking_for = excluded.looking_for, photos_json = excluded.photos_json, lat = excluded.lat, lng = excluded.lng, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: load_candidates
tools.description: Swipeable candidate pool for the caller: profiles matching the requested orientation, not yet swiped by the caller, and with no block in either direction. Age/distance narrowing happens client-side.
tools.sql: SELECT p.* FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id != :__user_id AND (:want_gender = 'any' OR p.gender = :want_gender) AND (p.looking_for = 'everyone' OR p.looking_for = :my_gender_target) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM swipes s WHERE s.swiper_id = :__user_id AND s.target_id = p.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id = :__user_id AND b.blocked_id = p.user_id) OR (b.blocker_id = p.user_id AND b.blocked_id = :__user_id)) ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT :pool

tools.name: record_swipe
tools.description: Record the caller's swipe on a target. The caller is always the swiper (server-derived).
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO swipes (swiper_id, target_id, direction, created_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :target_id, :direction, :__now)

tools.name: get_reciprocal_swipe
tools.description: The direction the target swiped on the caller, if any — used to decide whether a right-swipe just formed a mutual match
tools.sql: SELECT direction FROM swipes WHERE swiper_id = :target_id AND target_id = :__user_id

tools.name: create_match
tools.description: Create a match between the caller and a target — allowed ONLY when both have right-swiped each other and the caller is one of the two parties. Ids must be the ordered pair (a_id < b_id) and one of them must be the caller.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO matches (a_id, b_id, created_at) SELECT :a_id, :b_id, :__now WHERE (:a_id = :__user_id OR :b_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM swipes s1 WHERE s1.swiper_id = :a_id AND s1.target_id = :b_id AND s1.direction = 'right') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM swipes s2 WHERE s2.swiper_id = :b_id AND s2.target_id = :a_id AND s2.direction = 'right')

tools.name: load_my_matches
tools.description: The caller's matches (rows where the caller is either party), newest first
tools.sql: SELECT a_id, b_id, created_at FROM matches WHERE a_id = :__user_id OR b_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC

tools.name: load_messages
tools.description: Messages in one match conversation, oldest first — only readable when the caller is a participant of that match
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE match_a = :a_id AND match_b = :b_id AND (:__user_id = :a_id OR :__user_id = :b_id) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 500

tools.name: load_last_message
tools.description: The most recent message in one match conversation — only when the caller is a participant of that match
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE match_a = :a_id AND match_b = :b_id AND (:__user_id = :a_id OR :__user_id = :b_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message in a match. The sender is always the caller (server-derived), who must be a participant of the match AND the match must still exist (blocking/unmatching removes it).
tools.sql: INSERT INTO messages (id, match_a, match_b, sender_id, body, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :a_id, :b_id, :__user_id, :body, :__now WHERE (:__user_id = :a_id OR :__user_id = :b_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matches m WHERE m.a_id = :a_id AND m.b_id = :b_id)

tools.name: count_admirers
tools.description: How many people right-swiped the caller and haven't been swiped back yet (excluding blocks in either direction)
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM swipes s WHERE s.target_id = :__user_id AND s.direction = 'right' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM swipes me WHERE me.swiper_id = :__user_id AND me.target_id = s.swiper_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id = :__user_id AND b.blocked_id = s.swiper_id) OR (b.blocker_id = s.swiper_id AND b.blocked_id = :__user_id))

tools.name: load_admirers
tools.description: Profiles of people who right-swiped the caller and haven't been swiped back yet (excluding blocks in either direction), newest first
tools.sql: SELECT p.* FROM swipes s JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = s.swiper_id WHERE s.target_id = :__user_id AND s.direction = 'right' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM swipes me WHERE me.swiper_id = :__user_id AND me.target_id = s.swiper_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id = :__user_id AND b.blocked_id = s.swiper_id) OR (b.blocker_id = s.swiper_id AND b.blocked_id = :__user_id)) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: unmatch
tools.description: End a match the caller is part of and delete its conversation, atomically. The caller must be one of the two parties.
statements: DELETE FROM messages WHERE match_a = :a_id AND match_b = :b_id AND (:__user_id = :a_id OR :__user_id = :b_id)
DELETE FROM matches WHERE a_id = :a_id AND b_id = :b_id AND (:__user_id = :a_id OR :__user_id = :b_id)

tools.name: block_user
tools.description: Block another user: record the block (caller is the blocker), suppress them from discovery via a left-swipe, and tear down any existing match + conversation. Atomic.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO blocks (blocker_id, blocked_id, created_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :blocked_id, :__now)
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO swipes (swiper_id, target_id, direction, created_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :blocked_id, 'left', :__now)
DELETE FROM messages WHERE match_a = :a_id AND match_b = :b_id AND (:__user_id = :a_id OR :__user_id = :b_id)
DELETE FROM matches WHERE a_id = :a_id AND b_id = :b_id AND (:__user_id = :a_id OR :__user_id = :b_id)

tools.name: unblock_user
tools.description: Remove a block the caller previously created (caller is the blocker)
tools.sql: DELETE FROM blocks WHERE blocker_id = :__user_id AND blocked_id = :blocked_id

tools.name: is_blocked
tools.description: Whether a block exists between the caller and another user in either direction
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM blocks WHERE (blocker_id = :__user_id AND blocked_id = :other_id) OR (blocker_id = :other_id AND blocked_id = :__user_id)

tools.name: report_user
tools.description: File an abuse report against another user. The reporter is always the caller (server-derived).
tools.sql: INSERT INTO reports (id, reporter_id, reported_id, reason, note, created_at) VALUES (:__uuid, :__user_id, :reported_id, :reason, :note, :__now)

tools.name: seed_demo_profile
tools.description: Dev-only: upsert one placeholder demo profile. Guarded so it can only write ids prefixed 'demo-' — it can never impersonate a real platform user id.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO profiles (user_id, display_name, dob, bio, gender, looking_for, photos_json, lat, lng, updated_at) SELECT :user_id, :display_name, :dob, :bio, :gender, :looking_for, :photos_json, :lat, :lng, :updated_at WHERE :user_id LIKE 'demo-%' ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, dob = excluded.dob, bio = excluded.bio, gender = excluded.gender, looking_for = excluded.looking_for, photos_json = excluded.photos_json, lat = excluded.lat, lng = excluded.lng, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
